📺 Room 104 (2017–2020)

Room 104 is an anthology series set entirely inside a seemingly ordinary motel room, where each episode introduces different guests with unique and unpredictable stories. From strangers experiencing mysterious encounters to couples confronting complicated relationships, the room becomes the setting for bizarre, emotional, terrifying, and sometimes hilarious events. Although the location remains the same, every episode explores a different genre, ranging from psychological horror and supernatural mysteries to dark comedy and heartfelt drama. As the guests reveal their secrets, fears, desires, and personal struggles, seemingly ordinary situations often develop into extraordinary experiences. Created by brothers Mark and Jay Duplass, the series delivers unconventional storytelling, unexpected twists, and thought-provoking performances while exploring human nature, loneliness, identity, relationships, and the mysterious circumstances that can transform an ordinary night into an unforgettable experience.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Horror • Mystery • Dark Comedy • Anthology

⭐ IMDb: 6.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Mark Duplass & Jay Duplass

📺 Seasons: 4 • 48 Episodes

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max (United States; availability may vary).
